subject: planner: remove rejectSort field of physical property (#61852)
summary: Removes the unused/fragile `RejectSort` flag from `property.PhysicalProperty` and updates MPP-related property construction accordingly. Simplifies MPP `LogicalSort` plan enumeration to key off `TaskTp==MppTaskType` only and adds a nil-guard so MPP nominal-sort planning never returns a nil plan.
